profile.headline: Software Engineer at Osmose Utilities Services, Inc.
profile.summary:
Professional in Software, sharing and spreading knowledge, experience and works to companies of countries such as Venezuela and Ecuador. Effective on teams, able to achieve the corporate goals, recognized and recommended for being patient, reliable and hard worker able to learn quickly.

Professional experience in
• Software Design, Analysis and Development 
• Web Design and Development. 
• C++, C#, Java, Asp.Net, Visual Basic Languages and .NET Framework Programming.
• SQL and PostgreSQL Database Management and Programming.
• Computer Hardware and Cell Phone Repair and Maintenance.

Counting on good interpersonal and communicational skills and looking forward to joining professionals looking for making dreams come true...
